From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@cartiva.com>

Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Redwood for order enrichment

Hi Avery,

We just signed up and poked around the self-serve flow — Cartiva is evaluating real-time order enrichment (add product labels, fraud flags, and short free-text summaries) and your latency/cost story looks promising. I was hoping to schedule a quick demo to see how Redwood would fit into our stack.

Quick context: we process ~25k orders/day across NA, peak traffic in PST/EST. Typical flow is 1–3 enrichment calls per order; average request payload ~350 tokens after we stringify metadata. Expected pilot timeline: 4–8 weeks, with a production ramp in Q4.

Questions we want to surface during a short demo:
- Can you support p95 latency <150ms for a 512-token generation?
- How do you recommend batching vs prefix caching for this pattern?
- We need SSO + IP allowlist; do you support that in Hosted or only Dedicated?

I've attached a small traffic snapshot for last week (traffic-snapshot.csv) and a sample payload to show fields (sample-payload.json).

Can you propose 30-min windows next week? Prefer mornings PST.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Director of Product
Cartiva
olivia.chen@cartiva.com
+1 (415) 555-0113

Thanks, Avery — answers inline below.

> Average tokens per request (you noted ~350): is that prompt+expected completion or just payload?
- That’s payload only (fields we send). We expect a short generated completion ~40–60 tokens. So end-to-end ~400 tokens expected.

> Expected steady-state concurrency and peak burst?
- Steady-state ~8–12 RPS (across all regions), peak bursts up to ~65 RPS for 2–3 minutes during flash sales.

> Any PII in payloads?
- Minimal: order emails and first names. We can strip emails for the pilot if necessary. We do want KMS and audit logs for production.

> Pilot goal: throughput test only, or product quality eval?
- Both: we want to validate latency/cost and quality of the short summary/computed labels. We have a small eval set (50 examples) we can share before the call.

All three proposed windows are reasonable — booked the Wed slot (2027-06-16 10:00–10:30 PST) via your booking link.

Attaching sample-payload.json (contains placeholder fields only). Let me know if you want me to redact anything else prior to the call.

—
Olivia
